description: Defines the PacketDroppingTestWriter class, a test utility for simulating packet loss, reordering, delays, and socket blocking in QUIC protocol testing.

classes.name: PacketDroppingTestWriter
classes.description: A test utility class that simulates packet dropping, reordering, delays, and socket blocking for QUIC protocol testing.

classes.name: PacketDroppingTestWriter::Delegate
classes.description: An interface for callbacks triggered when the writer becomes writable.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the test writer with helper, alarm factory, and callback delegate.

methods.name: WritePacket
methods.description: Overrides the base method to simulate packet writing with loss, delay, and reordering.

methods.name: IsWriteBlocked
methods.description: Checks if the writer is currently blocked.

methods.name: GetNextWriteLocation
methods.description: Returns the next write location, disables zero-copy support.

methods.name: ReleaseOldPackets
methods.description: Sends out delayed packets that are due and returns the time for the next packet.

methods.name: SetDelayAlarm
methods.description: Sets the alarm for delayed packet transmission.

methods.name: OnCanWrite
methods.description: Callback when the writer becomes writable.

methods.name: set_fake_packet_loss_percentage
methods.description: Sets the simulated packet loss percentage.

methods.name: set_fake_drop_first_n_packets
methods.description: Configures dropping the first N packets unconditionally.

methods.name: set_fake_blocked_socket_percentage
methods.description: Sets the percentage of simulated socket blocking.

methods.name: set_fake_reorder_percentage
methods.description: Sets the percentage of packet reordering.

methods.name: set_fake_packet_delay
methods.description: Sets the delay before writing packets.

methods.name: set_max_bandwidth_and_buffer_size
methods.description: Configures bandwidth and buffer size for delaying packets.

methods.name: set_seed
methods.description: Sets seed for randomization, useful for reproducing flaky issues.

methods.name: ReleaseNextPacket
methods.description: Handles sending the next delayed packet.
